India Experiences Varied Weather Patterns Amidst Monsoon Activity

Several regions across India are experiencing diverse weather conditions as the monsoon progresses. While some areas like Delhi-NCR and Uttarakhand are receiving rainfall, offering relief from heat, others, particularly in the Northeast, are facing disruptions due to heavy rains and floods. Conversely, parts of Northwest India continue to grapple with severe heatwaves. The India Meteorological Department has issued various alerts, including orange and yellow alerts for rainfall in several states.
